campaign_role: Fourth of six CRs (CR070a-CR075a); the load-bearing cross-platform t_fire scaling test (one decisive yes/no on cross-platform generalization)

purpose: Apply the t_fire predictor formula (CR068a A_side = 1/24, exponential decoherence) to CR070a NV-diamond rows and CR072a photonic rows. Test whether the SAME constant c0_SAM generalizes across both populations. Compare against the textbook 1/e purity-decay convention as the portable reference, with the data gap (no partner-lab measured t_fire_observed values) documented honestly. Apply the locked load-bearing threshold (>= 8 PASS / < 4 FLOOR) against the 14 photonic rows available from CR072a.

comparison_reference.rationale: Under pure-dephasing exponential decay, t = T2/2 is when purity loss reaches 1 - 1/e (~0.632). This is the most common cross-platform 'alarm' equivalent in standard quantum-optics and quantum-information textbooks.
comparison_reference.data_gap_acknowledged: No published t_fire_observed values exist for either NV or photonic platforms; the PR letter A_side = 1/24 alarm is SAM-native. Partner-lab measurement is required to lift CR073a from PROVISIONAL_AGAINST_TEXTBOOK_REFERENCE to VERIFIED_AGAINST_PARTNER_LAB.

load_bearing_thresholds_locked_in_campai.precision_indicator: % of photonic rows within 0.15 (informational, not gating)
load_bearing_thresholds_locked_in_campai.drift_handling: absolute thresholds (>= 8 PASS, < 4 FLOOR) applied to the 14 available rows without cherry-picking 12; drift named in result_class and aggregate verdict

verification_discipline: CR073a runs the structural test against an internal reference (textbook 1/e convention). The load-bearing tolerance count and floor breach are reported honestly regardless of pass/fail. Partner-lab measurement of actual t_fire_observed values on either platform would lift CR073a to VERIFIED grade.
